items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Well, I played with the, Maxie. ... And man, we played that one night.

ctx.x: Well, I played with the, Maxie. Oh. Max had the, no dad had the, cause you know, the our band, Earl Crumb, and Monk Smith, Benji White, you know, Jelpy, all of them had bands. Well, they sold a band, and Mike had a beautiful tone, this last one. He was a musician, see? Had a band, and you got him playing in the band with him, George Beers. And man, we played that one night. He told everybody to wear what? Tuxedo. Man, you know, white colors. He was freezing cold. And George had to meet the artist. They used to…
We got out there, and Mac had a tuxedo all right, but with his overcoat, you know what I'm saying.

Get up there, man. He was playing the record, and I hear that one of his metal playing it like a surprise section, you know? Mm-hm. And that big, long seal had hold there, you know? And Mack had on the Tuxedo with his overcoat on, see. Get up there, man. He was playing a record for Client, I hear that, one of those metal playing it, like a sopranist act, you know? And that big, long, silly holder, you know? You see, you know, Mack had money and had a big, beautiful home of Matthew, you know? But he died,…
